newsitem.title: USA: Mason to pay about US $40,673 for survey.
newsitem.headline: Mason to pay about US $40,673 for survey.

text.p: Mason Oil Co Inc said Monday it signed a contract to pay Australian Geophysical Surveys about US$40,673 to survey areas covered by its Petroleum Exploration Licenses.
The survey will cover the Northern part of Petroleum Exploration License 61 and the Northeastern part of Petroleum Exploration License 63.
The company said the additional information will help in further evaluating the geology of the areas by correlating the magnetic information with existing seismic data.
The survey is scheduled to start July 20 and will cover about 6,163 line kilometers of flight survey.
When the survey is completed, the company will have 100 percent coverage of the license areas.
